mechanism: Ivermectin is a substrate and weak inhibitor of CYP3A4, which may increase dabigatran exposure; dabigatran is also a P-glycoprotein substrate and ivermectin may affect P-gp transporter activity.
action: Monitor for signs of bleeding; consider INR/PT monitoring if available or clinical assessment for bleeding manifestations; dose adjustment of dabigatran is generally not required but caution is warranted.
